## 5. Frontend Architecture (Next.js 16)

Production app at `/www/wwwroot/Lucifersdiary/lucifers-diary/frontend`, git branch `main` (HEAD `6dd9633`). App Router lives at `frontend/app/` (NOT `src/app/`); shared code in `frontend/lib/`, `frontend/components/`, `frontend/types/`. Note: package `name` is `frontend`, version `0.1.0`.

### 5.1 Stack & versions (from `frontend/package.json`)

| Area | Library | Version |
|---|---|---|
| Framework | `next` | `^16.2.6` (Next.js 16) |
| React | `react` / `react-dom` | pinned `19.2.4` |
| Styling | `tailwindcss` v4 + `@tailwindcss/postcss` `^4`, `tw-animate-css` `^1.4.0` | Tailwind **v4** (CSS-first, no `tailwind.config.js`) |
| Design tokens | `class-variance-authority` `^0.7.1`, `clsx` `^2.1.1`, `tailwind-merge` `^3.5.0` | shadcn-style |
| UI primitives | `@base-ui/react` `^1.4.1`, `shadcn` `^4.6.0` (`components/ui/*`), `lucide-react` `^1.14.0` | |
| Rich editor | TipTap **v3** — `@tiptap/react`, `@tiptap/starter-kit` + 12 extensions, all `^3.22.5` | see below |
| Animation | `gsap` `^3.15.0`, `@gsap/react` `^2.1.2` (`useGSAP`) | |
| Validation | `zod` `^4.4.3` | runtime API-response validation |
| Sanitization | `isomorphic-dompurify` `^3.12.0` | rich-text HTML sanitize |
| Lint | `eslint` `^9`, `eslint-config-next` `16.2.4` | |

**No declared Node `engines` field** in package.json (only the aaPanel runtime Node v24.15.0 is in play). No dedicated client-state library (Redux/Zustand) — state is local/hooks + cookies/localStorage. **No `next/font`** — six brand `@font-face` blocks are declared manually in `globals.css` pointing at local `.ttf`/`.woff2` under `app/fonts/`.

**TipTap extensions wired in `components/RichTextEditor.tsx`**: StarterKit (heading levels 2-4 / lists / blockquote / hr / codeBlock — all gated behind a `variant === "full"` flag; the "inline" variant disables them), Underline, Link (`openOnClick:false`, `autolink`, `rel=noopener noreferrer target=_blank`), Highlight, Subscript, Superscript, TextStyle, Color, Typography, TextAlign (full variant only), Placeholder, plus a **custom `Footnote` node** (`lib/tiptap-footnote.ts`) — an atom `<sup class="footnote" data-fn="…">` rendered via CSS counter + hover tooltip.

### 5.2 Routing — full App Router tree

**Public reading site (dynamic, SSR per request):**
- `/` (`app/page.tsx`) — marketing landing page (recently moved here; story rails moved to `/browse` per commits #172-176)
- `/browse` — story/series rails
- `/story/[id]`, `/chapter/[id]`, `/series/[id]` — reading pages (each with `page.module.css`, `opengraph-image.tsx`, `twitter-image.tsx`; chapter/story read `searchParams.page` for pagination)
- `/tag/[slug]` — tag-filtered listing (slug, not UUID)
- `/search` — reads `searchParams` (`search`, `tagIds`)
- `/privacy`, `/profile` (client), plus auth pages `/login`, `/signup` (both `"use client"`)
- `app/not-found.tsx`, `app/error` (admin)

**Admin / CMS (all `"use client"`, under `/admin`, gated):**
`/admin` (dashboard), `/admin/login`, `/admin/stories`, `/admin/stories/new`, `/admin/stories/[id]`, `/admin/series`, `/admin/series/new`, `/admin/series/[id]`, `/admin/series/[id]/page`, `/admin/series/[id]/chapters/new`, `/admin/series/[id]/chapters/[chapterId]`, `/admin/tags`. Local `_components/` (ContentForm, SeriesForm, TagPicker, NotesDrawer) use CSS Modules.

**Special / metadata routes (file-based, prerendered):**
`app/sitemap.ts` → `/sitemap.xml` (revalidate 3600), `app/feed.xml/route.ts` → `/feed.xml` (Atom, revalidate 3600/manifest shows 120), `app/robots.ts` → `/robots.txt`, `app/manifest.ts` → `/manifest.webmanifest`, root `app/opengraph-image.tsx` + `app/twitter-image.tsx` (`runtime="nodejs"`), `app/favicon.ico`. Per-content OG/Twitter image routes under story/chapter/series (all `runtime="nodejs"`, `revalidate=3600`, generated via `lib/og.tsx`).

**Middleware:** renamed to **`frontend/proxy.ts`** (Next.js 16's renamed-from-middleware file, exporting `proxy()` + `config.matcher`). Two jobs: (1) **/admin auth gate** — presence-check of the `lucifer_admin_session` httpOnly cookie; redirects unauthenticated `/admin/*` → `/admin/login?next=…`, and bounces `/admin/login` → `/admin/stories` when cookie present (crypto verification deferred to backend JwtStrategy per API call); (2) **per-request CSP nonce** — generates `btoa(crypto.randomUUID())`, threads it via `x-nonce` request header (read by `components/JsonLd.tsx`) and emits an **enforcing** `Content-Security-Policy` with `script-src 'self' 'nonce-…' 'strict-dynamic'`, `connect-src 'self' https://lucifersdiary.com`, `frame-ancestors 'none'`, etc.

### 5.3 Rendering & caching model

- **Almost every page is DYNAMIC (SSR per request).** The build's `prerender-manifest.json` prerenders **only** metadata routes (`feed.xml`, `opengraph-image`, `twitter-image`, `robots.txt`, `manifest.webmanifest`, `favicon.ico`, `_global-error`) — `dynamicRoutes` is empty. No content page generates static params (`generateStaticParams` is used nowhere). **Root cause of full-dynamic:** the root `layout.tsx` renders `<JsonLd>`, which reads the per-request `x-nonce` header set by `proxy.ts` — reading a request header opts every descendant page out of static rendering. The proxy comment explicitly documents and accepts this trade-off ("every page becomes dynamic … for this site's traffic profile that's acceptable").
- **API-level caching (in `lib/api.ts`)**: homepage/tag/list-feeder calls use `next: { revalidate: 120 }` (`HOMEPAGE_REVALIDATE`); reading/detail calls (`getStory`, `getChapter`, `getSeries`, `getStories`, `getSeriesList`) use `cache: "no-store"`; all like/reading-position calls are `no-store` + `credentials: "include"`. Because pages are dynamic, ISR doesn't apply — these flags govern data freshness, not page caching.
- **`next.config.ts` headers**: site-wide security header set (`X-Content-Type-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`, `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`, `Permissions-Policy`, `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin`, **`Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp`**, and prod-only HSTS `max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload`). `poweredByHeader:false`. **`/admin/:path*` gets `Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0` + `Pragma:no-cache` + `Expires:0`** — explicitly to avoid serving stale admin HTML that references now-deleted hashed chunks after a rebuild (the "CMS no-store" behavior). CSP is intentionally NOT emitted here (set dynamically in proxy.ts to avoid double headers).

### 5.4 Data layer & the `tags[].createdAt` contract drift

**API client:** `lib/api.ts` (public, server-component-safe) + `lib/adminApi.ts` (client-only, cookie-auth `credentials:'include'`, throws `AuthError` on 401 and hard-redirects to `/admin/login`). Both read `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` (fallback `http://localhost:3001/api`).

**Zod validation pattern:** the `request<T>(path, init, schema?)` helper in `lib/api.ts` does `fetch → res.json() → schema.safeParse`. **On mismatch it does NOT throw** — it logs `console.warn("[API] Schema mismatch for <path>:", result.error.issues)` and falls through with `data as T` (deliberately preserving pre-validation behavior; comment flags this as audit concern "C07"). Schemas live in `lib/schemas.ts`, mirroring `types/index.ts` and annotated `z.ZodType<T>` so a drifting field is a compile error in the schema file.

**ROOT CAUSE of the build-time `[API] Schema mismatch … tags[].createdAt expected string received undefined`:**

- The exact schema is **`TagSchema` in `frontend/lib/schemas.ts`**, backing the **`Tag` interface in `frontend/types/index.ts`**:
  ```
  export const TagSchema: z.ZodType<Tag> = z.object({
    id, name, slug, isAdult, createdAt: z.string(),   // ← REQUIRED string
  });
  ```
  `TagSchema` is embedded (via `z.array(TagSchema)`) inside **every** card/detail schema: `StoryCardSchema`, `ChapterCardSchema`, `SeriesCardSchema`, `Homepage{Story,Chapter}CardSchema`, `FullStorySchema`, `FullChapterSchema`, `SeriesDetailSchema`.
- **The backend deliberately omits `createdAt` on nested tags.** The Prisma `Tag` model DOES have `createdAt DateTime @default(now())`, but every nested tag relation across the backend selects only four fields:
  `tags: { select: { tag: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true, isAdult: true } } } }`
  This identical pattern appears in `stories.service.ts`, `series.service.ts`, `chapters.service.ts`, `homepage.service.ts`, and `recommendations.service.ts`. The flattened tag objects returned by these endpoints therefore have `createdAt === undefined`.
- **Contract drift:** any homepage/list/detail response feeder (e.g. `getLatestStories`, `getMostLiked`, `getStory`, `getSeries`, `getChapter`) returns tags without `createdAt`, so `TagSchema.safeParse` fails with exactly `tags[].createdAt expected string received undefined`. It surfaces "during build" because the homepage/landing fetches run at render time (and SSG-feeder calls during `next build`). It is **non-fatal** — the warn-and-fall-through means the page still renders, but it is silent type-safety erosion (the cast asserts a field the runtime data lacks; consumers reading `tag.createdAt` would get `undefined`).
- **Note the asymmetry:** the bare tag endpoints `/tags` (`findAllUsed`/`findMany`) and `/tags/by-slug/:slug` (`findUnique`) in `tags.service.ts` use **no `select`**, so they DO return `createdAt` — `getTags()`/`getTagBySlug()` validate cleanly. Only the **nested** tag arrays drift.
- **Fix options:** either add `createdAt: true` to the five nested `select` blocks in the backend, OR make `createdAt` optional (`z.string().optional()` / `createdAt?: string`) in the frontend `Tag` schema+type since the public UI never appears to consume tag `createdAt`.

### 5.5 Components & design system

- **`components/`** (~60 components, each paired with a CSS Module): reading UX (`ReadingView`, `ReadingPrefs`, `RichText`, `ChapterProgressTracker`, `TextFragmentScroller`, `ResumeReadingRow`, `ContinueCard`), engagement (`LikeButton`, `SaveButton`, `FollowButton`, `ShareButton`, `QuoteShare`), discovery (`SearchBar`, `CommandPalette`, `TagBar`/`TagPill`, `CardGrid`, `StoryCard`, `SeriesCard`, `RecommendationsRow`, `RelatedSection`), gating (`AgeGate`, `NsfwModal`, `PublicGates`, `BlockedTagsApplier/Button`), chrome (`SiteHeader`, `UserMenu`, `ThemeSwitcher`, `DevilHorn`), SEO (`JsonLd`). **`components/ui/`** holds the shadcn/Base-UI primitives: `badge, button, dialog, dropdown-menu, input, sheet, switch, table, textarea, tooltip`. GSAP `useGSAP` is used in `SiteHeader`, `ReadingView`, `CardGrid`, `LikeButton`, `ExpandableSection`, `BlockedTagsButton`, `ReadingPrefs`, and `admin/layout.tsx`.
- **`lib/`**: `api.ts`/`adminApi.ts` (clients), `schemas.ts` (Zod), `site.ts` (canonical URL/SEO constants), `og.tsx` (OG image gen), `richtext.ts`/`tiptap-footnote.ts`, `gsap.ts`, plus client hooks (`useReadingPosition`, `useBottomSheetDrag`), `readTracker`/`readingProgress`, `session`/`userAuth`, `blockedTags`, `heat`, `surprise`, `share`, `format`, `utils`.

**The two repo-root "design system" folders are NOT in the Next.js build — they are external design assets / a Claude Code skill:**
- **`Lucifer's Diary Design System/`** — a packaged **Claude Code skill** (`SKILL.md` front-matter: `name: lucifers-diary-design`, `user-invocable: true`). Contains `README.md` (brand bible — "dark literary magazine read by lamplight"), `colors_and_type.css` (CSS custom properties + base styles, the token source of truth), `fonts/` (the variable TTFs), `preview/` (~24 static HTML spec cards: colors, type scale, spacing, radii, glyphs, and component cards for buttons/badges/tags/story-card/pagination/like-button/author's-note/input), and `ui_kits/{public,admin}/` (throwaway JSX mock kits — `Homepage.jsx`, `StoryPage.jsx`, `SeriesPage.jsx`, admin `Sidebar/Dashboard/PostEditor/PostsTable.jsx`). README documents **hard brand rules**: no emoji, no drop shadows (elevation via surface ramp + borders), no gradients, accent gold `#BF9B5E` only for tags/Author's-Note/primary-CTA/active-pagination, exactly three font families (Playfair Display / Lora / DM Sans), warm off-white text `#EDE8DE` (never pure white).
- **`lucife'r sdiary Hi-Fi design/`** (note the typo'd folder name with embedded space/apostrophe) — an **earlier Hi-Fi mockup**: raw `.jsx` mock pages (`Homepage.jsx`, `StoryPage.jsx`, `SeriesPage.jsx`, `AgeGate.jsx`, `tweaks-panel.jsx`), a standalone `Lucifer's Diary.html`, a `ds/` token copy, and an `uploads/` folder of reference JPG/PNG screenshots + `DESIGN.md`. This is the older design source the formal Design System folder superseded.
- Also at repo root: `icons/SVG/` (icon assets) and `docs/` (`PROJECT.md`, `tag_taxonomy_3_tiers.md`, `tag_extras.json`).

### 5.6 Config keys — `frontend/.env.local` (build-time inlined)

Only two keys, **both `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` and therefore inlined into the JS bundle at `next build` time** (changing either requires a rebuild + PM2 restart, per `.env.local.example` warning — setting them only in PM2 runtime env does nothing). Values are public URLs (not secrets), pointing at the production domain:
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL = https://lucifersdiary.com/api`
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL = https://lucifersdiary.com`

`lib/site.ts` derives `SITE_URL` (trailing-slash-stripped), `SITE_NAME` ("Lucifer's Diary"), `SITE_DESCRIPTION` ("Dark, literary erotica and long-form sex stories from a single author."), and `SITE_AUTHOR` (pseudonym "Lucifer") from these. The repo also keeps `.env.local.example` (well-documented) and a stale `.env.local.save` backup.

### 5.7 Notable risks / tech debt / anomalies

1. **`tags[].createdAt` contract drift (above)** — silent across all nested-tag endpoints; logs a warning every build/render but never fails, eroding the Zod guarantee. Frontend type asserts a field the API doesn't send.
2. **Stale code comments referencing the old `middleware.ts`** — `lib/adminApi.ts` and `lib/api.ts` comments still cite `frontend/middleware.ts`, but the file is now `proxy.ts` (Next.js 16 rename). Doc rot, harmless functionally.
3. **Whole-site dynamic rendering** — the per-request CSP nonce + `JsonLd` in the root layout forces every page to SSR (no ISR/static). Accepted by design, but every reader hit re-renders server-side and (for detail pages) re-fetches with `no-store`; the only caching cushion is the 2-minute revalidate on homepage feeder calls. A traffic spike hits the NestJS API directly.
4. **`Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp` is enabled** — fine today (everything same-origin, local fonts), but any future third-party embed/CDN/script will silently break under COEP+CORP unless explicitly CORP-tagged.
5. **No `engines` pin** in package.json — Node version (v24.15.0) is implicit to the aaPanel install; a different Node could change build behavior.
6. **Admin auth gate is presence-only at the edge** — `proxy.ts` only checks cookie existence; real verification is per-API-call on the backend. A forged/expired-but-present cookie passes the edge gate and is rejected only on the first API call (acceptable defense-in-depth, but worth noting).

Key files: `/www/wwwroot/Lucifersdiary/lucifers-diary/frontend/lib/schemas.ts` (TagSchema), `/www/wwwroot/Lucifersdiary/lucifers-diary/frontend/types/index.ts` (Tag), `/www/wwwroot/Lucifersdiary/lucifers-diary/frontend/lib/api.ts` (request helper + warn pattern), `/www/wwwroot/Lucifersdiary/lucifers-diary/frontend/proxy.ts`, `/www/wwwroot/Lucifersdiary/lucifers-diary/frontend/next.config.ts`, `/www/wwwroot/Lucifersdiary/lucifers-diary/backend/src/{stories,series,chapters,homepage,recommendations}/*.service.ts` (nested tag `select` omitting `createdAt`), `/www/wwwroot/Lucifersdiary/lucifers-diary/backend/src/tags/tags.service.ts` (bare tag endpoints that DO include createdAt).
